newsitem.title: USA: S. Calif. water district okays $500 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: S. Calif. water district okays $500 mln bond issue.

text.p: The board of directors of Metropolitan Water District of Southern California announced the sale of up to $500 million in water revenue bonds.
The funds, to be raised through a negotiated sale, will be used to continue the agency's 10-year, $3.9 billion capital improvement program, the water district said.

Metropolitan Water District chief financial officer Lambertus Becker said expenditures for the capital improvement program are budgeted to be $518 million during 1996-1997 and approximately $800 million in 1997-1998. As of June 30, the district had $334 million of construction funds on hand.

Becker recommended the board raise additional funds through the issuance of commercial paper, fixed or variable rate water revenue bonds late in 1996 or in early 1997. The district's commercial paper program can be expanded by up to $270 million under authority previously approved by the board.
